name: Incolor SSR
why_interesting: An electronic-only aero frameset with an integrated seat mast, broad seven-size range and up to 36 mm clearance in a 1× build.
missing: Dated mainland-China RMB observation and purchase route
Manufacturer confirmation of generation and warranty
Independent frame-weight, rider-limit and quality-control evidence

facts.frame: 80T/T1100-claimed carbon with integrated seat mast; electronic shifting only

price_status: discovery-only official PDF lead; not displayed as a current catalog price
support_note: The official mainland route is the Taobao flagship or dealer locator. InColor states lifetime carbon frame/fork coverage, five years for listed carbon components and two years for metal components, subject to purchase and normal-use conditions.
source_note: The 750 g claim is for an unpainted size-54 frame with the integrated seat mast. A 2× build is limited to 32C; 36C applies to 1×. An official PDF lead showed ¥29,800 standard and ¥23,800 custom-geometry packages, but the PDF timed out, so neither is promoted as current.
